request.body: {"displayName": "Shape_retail_small", "type": "Notebook", "definition": {"format": "ipynb", "parts": [{"path": "notebook-content.ipynb", "payload": "{\"nbformat\": 4, \"nbformat_minor\": 5, \"metadata\": {\"kernelspec\": {\"display_name\": \"Python 3\", \"language\": \"python\", \"name\": \"python3\"}, \"language_info\": {\"name\": \"python\", \"version\": \"3.11.0\"}}, \"cells\": [{\"cell_type\": \"markdown\", \"metadata\": {}, \"source\": [\"# Shape data generation: Retail\\n\", \"\\n\", \"This notebook generates synthetic data with **Shape v0.0.0**.\\n\", \"\\n\", \"- **Domain**: retail\\n\", \"- **Scale**: small\\n\", \"- **Seed**: 42\\n\", \"- **Output**: lakehouse\"]}, {\"cell_type\": \"code\", \"metadata\": {}, \"source\": [\"%pip install sqllocks-shape==0.0.0 sqllocks-shape-domains==0.0.0 -q\"], \"outputs\": [], \"execution_count\": null}, {\"cell_type\": \"code\", \"metadata\": {}, \"source\": [\"import shape\\n\", \"\\n\", \"result = shape.generate('retail', scale='small', seed=42)\\n\", \"\\n\", \"for name, table in result.tables.items():\\n\", \"    print(f\\\"{name:<28}{table.num_rows:>12,} rows{table.num_columns:>4} columns\\\")\\n\", \"print(f\\\"{sum(result.row_counts.values()):,} rows in {len(result.tables)} tables\\\")\\n\", \"\\n\", \"problems = result.verify_integrity()\\n\", \"if problems:\\n\", \"    print(\\\"Foreign-key integrity problems:\\\")\\n\", \"    for problem in problems:\\n\", \"        print(f\\\"  WARNING: {problem}\\\")\\n\", \"else:\\n\", \"    print(\\\"Foreign-key integrity: PASS\\\")\"], \"outputs\": [], \"execution_count\": null}, {\"cell_type\": \"markdown\", \"metadata\": {}, \"source\": [\"## Write to the Lakehouse\\n\", \"\\n\", \"Writes every table as a Parquet file under the default Lakehouse's `Files` folder. Attach a Lakehouse to this notebook first.\"]}, {\"cell_type\": \"code\", \"metadata\": {}, \"source\": [\"import os\\n\", \"import pyarrow.parquet as pq\\n\", \"\\n\", \"lakehouse_path = os.environ.get(\\n\", \"    'LAKEHOUSE_FILES_PATH', '/lakehouse/default/Files'\\n\", \")\\n\", \"output_dir = f\\\"{lakehouse_path}/shape/retail\\\"\\n\", \"os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)\\n\", \"\\n\", \"paths = []\\n\", \"for name, table in result.tables.items():\\n\", \"    path = f\\\"{output_dir}/{name}.parquet\\\"\\n\", \"    pq.write_table(table, path)\\n\", \"    paths.append(path)\\n\", \"    print(f\\\"  Written: {path}\\\")\\n\", \"\\n\", \"print(f\\\"{len(paths)} tables written to {output_dir}\\\")\"], \"outputs\": [], \"execution_count\": null}]}", "payloadType": "InlineText"}, {"path": ".platform", "payload": "{\"$schema\": \"https://developer.microsoft.com/json-schemas/fabric/gitIntegration/platformProperties/2.0.0/schema.json\", \"metadata\": {\"type\": \"Notebook\", \"displayName\": \"Shape_retail_small\"}, \"config\": {\"version\": \"2.0\", \"logicalId\": \"c9fff23a-256d-588b-afb9-bba853c94b3a\"}}", "payloadType": "InlineText"}]}}
